name: Rail
summary: A narrow column of icon destinations with short labels, a start and an end: the Studio rail.
useWhen: Three to seven top level destinations of a tool or editor, beside a canvas that needs the width
Destinations that each have a clear icon and a one word name
A column that switches the panel next to it (layers, assets, comments)
The collapsed form of app navigation that never needs groups or long names
avoidWhen: More than seven destinations, or destinations that fall into named groups
Destinations whose names do not fit in one short word
Three to five destinations on a phone layout
Actions that change data, such as Save or Delete

label.description: The accessible name of the nav landmark: Main, Tools. Not drawn.

size.description: Item height from size.control: md is size.control.md (32px, 28px compact, 36px comfortable), sm is size.control.sm (28px). Under data-platform ios or android items grow to size.touch.ios (44pt) or size.touch.android (48dp) for touch templates. Never under size.target-min.

hideLabels.description: Draws only the icons; each label stays the accessible name and shows in a Tooltip on hover and focus. Sets data-hide-labels.

start.description: The block start of the column: a brand mark or a workspace switcher.

end.description: The block end of the column: account, help or settings RailItems, rendered as a second list.

RailItem.href.description: Where the item goes. Removed while disabled.

RailItem.icon.description: A system icon name or a node. Hidden from assistive tech.

RailItem.label.description: One short word, shown under the icon and used as the accessible name. A longer one ends in an ellipsis.

RailItem.badge.description: A count on the icon's corner (over 99 shows 99+, 0 and false draw nothing), or true for a dot. A dot needs badgeLabel.

RailItem.badgeLabel.description: What the badge means, read after the label: 3 new. Needed for a dot.

RailItem.active.description: The current page: aria-current page, data-active, a fill, bold label and an edge bar.

RailItem.disabled.description: Removes the href, sets role link, aria-disabled and data-disabled, and stays in the tab order. With asChild the plain anchor renders instead of the router child, so the child's own click never runs.

RailItem.asChild.description: Renders the single child element, a router link with no children, as the item.

a11y.role: navigation (nav with aria-label) holding a list of links
a11y.focus: Every item is a tab stop, disabled ones included. An inset 2px ring from color.focus.ring.
a11y.announce: The label is the accessible name, then the badge: Inbox 3, or Boards New activity with badgeLabel. The current item says current page.
notes: Every item has a visible label by default. With hideLabels, and for any label cut to an ellipsis, the item shows a Tooltip with the full label on hover and focus, at the inline end (WCAG 1.4.13). The hint repeats the name, so it is not wired as the description.
The current page is shown by aria-current, a fill, a bold label and an edge bar, never by color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).
Items in end form a second list after the main one, so a screen reader hears two lists.

Targets: md items are size.control.md (32px) and sm items size.control.sm (28px) at default density, never under 24px (WCAG 2.5.8). Only data-platform ios or android grows them to 44 or 48px for touch templates.
The border and the active bar sit on logical sides, so they flip in RTL.
Labels carry dir auto, so a Latin label in an Arabic rail ends in its own ellipsis.

en.label: One noun in sentence case: Home, Files, Search.
en.badge: A plain number. A dot needs badgeLabel: New activity.

ar.label: One noun, no diacritics: الرئيسية، الملفات، البحث.

react.behavior: hand built nav, radix:Slot for asChild, Tooltip for hidden or cut labels
react.note: The hover veil fades on duration.fast and is instant under reduced motion. Round 2 (order 1.22, proposed): nav-current-slide (the edge bar ::before slides along the column, the icons dip and pop), nav-hover-follow (the hover veil slides from the item the pointer left) and sidebar-collapse (hideLabels moves the icons with flipPlay and the labels rise in after them).

native.note: Phones use TabBar; a tablet navigation rail comes with the touch templates in wave 2.

styles.studio: Flat surface with a hairline on the inline end edge; the active item takes an overlay fill, bright text and a white edge bar.
styles.desk: The same layout; the edge bar and the badge take the yellow primary.
styles.neutral: Takes the tokens of the Neutral style, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: Icons with no label and no Tooltip
mistakes.right: Visible labels, or hideLabels with a Tooltip on each item

mistakes.wrong: Two word labels that end in an ellipsis
A dot badge with no badgeLabel
mistakes.right: badgeLabel that says what the dot means

mistakes.wrong: Buttons that save or delete in the rail
mistakes.right: Items only navigate; actions go in a Toolbar
